prior_turns.answer_excerpt: In the AWS VPN Client, disconnect and quit the client, check that a TAP-Windows adapter is installed (reinstall the client if not), then download a fresh configuration file and import it as a new profile.

prior_turns.question: SSH connection timed out to my EC2 instance.
prior_turns.answer_excerpt: A timed-out SSH connection usually means the security group doesn't allow inbound port 22 from your IP, or the route table has no route to an internet gateway. Check both, then connect with ssh -i your key.

why: Both causes on the page were ruled out.

why: The page's fix was applied; something else (SCP, resource policy) blocks it.
